answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before its first voyage through the marketplace, with the stake growing after each verified trade. Like a juniper taking root slowly, reputation accrues only through completed work, so a Sybil attacker must fund thousands of separate deposits and wait out the same slow seasoning. Crystal-clear on-chain history makes cheap mass identities unprofitable, because each fake costs real capital and time while honest agents keep their stake.
